first_public_date_basis: Beginning of publicly documented 28th IEEE ICECS conference, 2021-11-28 to 2021-12-01; exact day that manuscript first became available online is not separately established.
scientific_integrity: Pure real polynomial dynamics; strict rational certificate for every real parameter in [0.9978,0.9982], not only sample simulations. Published family and parameters directly checked.
scientific_limitations: Certified nonmaximal interval and local basin only; does not prove global lack of coexisting chaos. Historical publication priority not independently audited.
title: An explicit attracting period-four window in a self-parameterized logistic map
